name: binhex-healarr
description: Healarr monitors Docker containers for unhealthy status and automatically performs configurable actions (restart, stop, etc.) with retry logic to prevent false positives. It supports filtering by container label, environment variable, or name, and includes comprehensive logging.

paths.name: Path: /config
paths.description: This is the container path to your configuration files, e.g. databases, configuration files, logs etc.

paths.name: Path: /var/run/docker.sock
paths.description: Docker socket for container management - REQUIRED if not using DOCKER_HOST. Remove this if using Docker socket proxy.

variables.name: Variable: DOCKER_HOST
variables.description: Docker socket proxy address (e.g. 'tcp://dockersocket:2375'). Use this as a secure alternative to mounting /var/run/docker.sock. Leave empty to use direct socket mount.

variables.name: Variable: MONITOR_INTERVAL
variables.description: Time in seconds between checking for containers that are 'unhealthy' (default: 60).

variables.name: Variable: RETRY_COUNT
variables.description: Number of times to verify unhealthy status before taking action (default: 3).

variables.name: Variable: RETRY_DELAY
variables.description: Time in seconds to wait between retry health checks (default: 10).

variables.name: Variable: ACTION
variables.description: Docker action to execute on unhealthy containers: restart, stop, pause, unpause, kill or none (no action).

variables.name: Variable: CONTAINER_LABEL
variables.description: Filter containers by label (e.g. 'com.example.monitor=true'). Filters use OR logic.

variables.name: Variable: CONTAINER_ENV_VAR
variables.description: Filter containers by environment variable (e.g. 'MONITOR_ENABLED=true'). Filters use OR logic.

variables.name: Variable: CONTAINER_NAME
variables.description: Filter containers by name, comma-separated (e.g. 'sonarr,radarr,plex'). Filters use OR logic.

variables.name: Variable: APPRISE_NOTIFICATION_SERVICES
variables.description: Comma-separated list of Apprise service URLs for notifications (e.g. 'mailto://user:pass@gmail.com,discord://webhook_id/webhook_token').

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
variables.description: The command or script to execute, if not specified then the script healthcheck.sh will be used (process, dns and https checking).

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_ACTION
variables.description: The action to execute if the healthcheck command returns a non zero exit code, if not specified the action will be 'exit 1', if you want the container to exit on failure then set the action to 'kill 1'.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_HOSTNAME
variables.description: The hostname used when performing HTTPS and DNS healthchecking.

variables.name: Variable: PUID
variables.description: User ID for the running container

variables.name: Variable: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for the running container

author: binhex
